A view that shows the waveform of an [`archetypes.AssetAudio`](https://rerun.io/docs/reference/types/archetypes/asset_audio?speculative-link) and plays it back.

Audio plays while time is playing on a temporal timeline, starting from the time the asset was logged.

## Properties

### `playback`
Playback settings, such as volume and muting.
